impact.text: This will cause vaults with premium positions to experience significant NAV miscalculations.

precondition_sources.text: The vault has premium positions whose exposure is computed by computeNAV().

intent_sources.text: NAV computed by computeNAV() should reflect the correct premium exposure so that a vault with net positive token1 premium does not lose value in the NAV calculation.
